book.name: 1 KORINITA
book.title: Paulo La Ginigini Yamatala BaisaMINA KORINITA

content: Yakama Yaubada la towotetila

E segwaia, omitibogwa gala gagabila balivala baisa yokomi makawala baisa matausina Baloma Tobumaboma eisikaila. Mitaga eibodi alivala baisa yokomi makawala baisa mina watanawa, kaina makawala yokomi gugwadi wala olumoulela tapwaroru.
Eibodi nunu avinunaimi mitaga gala bibodi kaulotoula bavakomaimi, uula paila omitibogwa yokomi gugwadi wala olumoulela tapwaroru. E ka, tuta baisa goli yokomi gugwadi wala olumoulela tapwaroru,

paila lokusisuaisi makawala mina watanawa. Igau wala isisu oluwalaimi bubunela pogi, kaina yowai taitala baisa taitala, mokwita goli yokomi mina watanawa wala, deli mi kaisisu kububunasi makawala baisa ovalu watanawa.
Avai tuta taitala bikaibiga, kawala, “Ka, yeigu Paulo la boda,” deli taiyuwela bikaibiga, kawala, “E yeigu Apolo
la boda,” - ki, yokomi kububunasi makawala mina watanawa wala, kadai!
Mitaga availa Apolo? E availa Paulo? Ka, baisa yakama wala, e yakama Yaubada la towotetila. E kavakadaimi kidamwa bukudubumaisi wala. E yakama kawotetila avai wotetila Guyau isaiki taitala taitala.
Yeigu Paulo asopu yagogu, e matauna Apolo ikaivatam. Mitaga matauna Yaubada uulela ivasusuni e ivitubwi matamna.
Availa tosopu kaina tokavatam, matausina gala avaka. Yaubada wala uulotoula, paila ivasusuni e ivitubwi.
Gala avaka kala tuwoli tosopu deli tokavatam. Yaubada bisaiki taitala taitala kala mapu makawala avaka bibodi la paisewa matauna.
Paila yakama katamgogula ma paisewa paila Yaubada, e yokomi goli Yaubada la bagula. E tuvaila yokomi Yaubada la bwala.

E Yaubada isemakavi peula baisa yeigu kidamwa yeigu bakimadagi. E mapaila yeigu tokimadagi lakatubiasi e tumila lakusoi. E tuta baisa taitala ituwoli ikikaliai baisa. E ibodi wala tokwaliai taitala taitala biyamati ammakawala la kaliai.
Paila Yaubada bogwa ikatubiasi tumila makwaina tumilatoula, e gala avai tumila tuvaila bisisu. Baisa wala matauna Yesu Keriso kalamwaguta. E gala gagabila availa bikusoi tumila ituwoli.
Kidamwa tomota bikaliaisi odabala tumila makwaina, mimilisi mbwailisi bikaliaisi metoya wa goula, kaina siliba, kaina bekwa kaiginigini. Mimilisiga iyebwailisi kaimakava wala, kaina yoyu, kaina levi.
E taitala taitala la kaliai kala bwaina bitagisi igau tutala yam makwaina Yamla Keriso
biyomitali makwaina. Paila yam makwaina kovala saina kovaveka, e makovana biyomitali komwaidosi si kaliai. Paila kova bigabukoli e bivituloki la kaliai avaka kala bwaina mokwita.
Kidamwa availa la kaliai gala bigabu wa yam makwaina mitaga bitogaga, e matauna bibani kala mapu.
Mitaga kidamwa availa la kaliai bivakakovi, e bogwa bitamwau. Mitaga matauna titoulela bimova, makawala goli leisakawoligili makovana kova.
Ki! Mokwita bogwa kunikolaisi kidamwa yokomi Yaubada la bwala kwebumaboma, e kidamwa Yaubada la Baloma isikailimi.

Ka, kugisaisi! Kidamwaga availa Yaubada la bwala kwebumaboma bikodidaimi, e Yaubada bogwa bikatumati matauna. Paila Yaubada la bwala kwebumaboma bomikikila goli, e yokomi titoulemi eivigaki la bwala kwebumaboma.
Gala bibodi availa bikayupali titoulela. Kidamwa avai tau yokomi idoki titoulela toninitalapula omitasi mina watanawa, ibodi bivigaki titoulela makawala tonagowa, kidamwa bimila tokabitamtoula.
Paila baisa avaka mina watanawa idokaisi kabitam, baisa Yaubada idoki lubulobwaga wala. Makawala Buki Pilabumaboma kala ginigini isisu, “Yaubada isikoli toninitalapula si kateta.”
E tuvaila Buki Pilabumaboma kala ginigini isisu, “E Guyau bogwa inikoli toninitalapula si nanamsa vavagi vigimakava wala.”
E gala ibodi availa bikamnomwana paila avaka tomota gagabila bivagaisi. Mitaga vavagi komwaidona baisa mi vavagi goli;
makawala Paulo, Apolo, Pita, - e valu watanawa, momova, kaliga, tuta baisa deli tuta oluvi, komwaidona vavagi makwaisina baisa mi vavagi goli.
E yokomi Keriso la vavagi. E Keriso matauna Yaubada la vavagi.
